facts.fact: 匿名日记页（Voices from the Void 摘录）写：当年彼此反目是“fighting each other over shadows”；作者为丢下 Marble 没救道歉，如今困在裂隙里，只能祈祷有人找到他。
facts.anchor: I’m sorry, Marble. If I hadn’t left you to die

facts.fact: Pet 说出心裂者的话（说他拖累 Jade、不懂医学）；Jade 反驳说那生物会乱激素让人抑郁，过一阵就会过去。
facts.anchor: that I hold you back and don’t really know anything about medicine

facts.fact: Jade 抓住一只 moss rat（“the size of a surface beaver”），拔刀去猎肉，让 Pet 和 Flint 生火做饭。
facts.anchor: She pulls out her knives and heads toward the rabbits.

facts.fact: 休息前 Pet 看 tracker：第五格跳到“one hour”，下潜总时长计数为“seventy-four hours”。
facts.anchor: The gauge counting my total time down here says seventy-four hours.

facts.fact: 露营时 Jade 问 Void Truther Flint 下潜所求，Flint 答：“The monster that killed our mother”。
facts.anchor: The monster that killed our mother,” he deadpans.

facts.fact: Pet 主动提出帮 Flint 杀 surfacewalker，Flint 同意；Jade 斥他：“Survival requires selfishness”，Pet 当晚不语。
facts.anchor: Don’t offer our help so lightly, Pet. Survival requires selfishness.

facts.fact: Flint 脚踩塌地面；Pet 抓住他的包想拉回，Jade 从下方托起 Pet 手臂猛拽，Flint 从 Pet 手里滑落掉进洞口。
facts.anchor: But Jade’s arms scoop under mine, and she yanks me with such force

facts.fact: Pet 不听 Jade 劝阻跳进塌洞，落地后看到洞底到处是扭曲的血肉尸体。
facts.anchor:
Bodies everywhere.

Twisted in mangled, bloody piles.
